content_sections.heading: About INST Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: The Institute of Nano Science and Technology (INST) is an autonomous research institute of the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India, located at Knowledge City, Sector-81, SAS Nagar, Mohali-140306, Punjab. The JRF will work in the BRNS-funded project "Biomass derived agents to assist synergistic hydrogen and chemical production: Prototype Reactor Fabrication". The Principal Investigator of the project is Dr. Kamalakannan Kailasam, Scientist-G.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The research experience is listed as desirable, not essential. The notice does not list the categories or the years of relaxation; it refers to the rules of the Government of India. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

rows.details: M. Sc. Chemistry with a minimum of 55% marks and must have a valid CSIR/ UGC NET or GATE qualification
Minimum 3 year of research experience in organic and inorganic material synthesis, characterization techniques and catalysis
Must not be over 28 years as on 16th November, 2026
Relaxable for certain reserved categories as per rules of Government of India

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Fellowship: Rs. 37,000/- (pm), with HRA paid in addition as per the funding agency guidelines. Duration: initially for a period of one year, and it may be extended based on the performance of the candidate and the availability of funds. The position is purely temporary and on contractual basis. The position is co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for INST Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: The notice asks candidates to send an application by email before the walk-in interview and then attend the interview in person. Get the application form in the prescribed format from https://www.inst.ac.in/careers . Email the filled application form, with copies of age proof, certificates, degrees, mark sheets and other testimonials, to [email protected] tentatively by 14 November 2026 . Report for the walk-in interview at INST, Mohali at 10.00 a.m. on 16th and 17th November, 2026. Application form in the prescribed format (by email) Copies of age proof, certificates, degrees, mark sheets and other testimonials (by email) Original age proof, certificates, degrees, mark sheets and other testimonials, with self-attested photocopies (at the interview)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview held on 16th and 17th November, 2026. The reporting time is 10.00 a.m. and the venue is INST, Mohali. At the time of interview, candidates must present the original documents of age proof, certificates, degrees, mark sheets and other testimonials along with self-attested photocopies of these documents. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in INST Recruitment 2026 for JRF?
faq.answer: There is 01 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in the BRNS-funded project at INST, Mohali.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to email the INST JRF application?
faq.answer: The application form with documents should be emailed to [email protected] tentatively by 14 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When and where is the INST JRF walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 16th and 17th November, 2026, with reporting at 10.00 a.m. at INST, Mohali.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for the INST JRF post?
faq.answer: M. Sc. Chemistry with a minimum of 55% marks and a valid CSIR/UGC NET or GATE qualification. Research experience of minimum 3 year in organic and inorganic material synthesis, characterization techniques and catalysis is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the INST JRF post?
faq.answer: The candidate must not be over 28 years as on 16th November, 2026, relaxable for certain reserved categories as per rules of Government of India.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the INST JRF?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 37,000/- (pm) + HRA (as funding agency guidelines).

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the INST JRF fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes. HRA is paid in addition to the Rs. 37,000/- (pm) fellowship, as per the funding agency guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. Is the INST JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary, on contractual basis and co-terminus with the project; it is initially for one year and may be extended based on performance and availability of funds.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the INST JRF interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can the selected INST JRF join a PhD programme?
faq.answer: Yes. The selected candidate can also apply for the regular PhD program of INST, provided they satisfy its eligibility criteria.
